test_coverage: IndexStatusWidgetLoftMedia.test.tsx:41-68 renders the widget with frame_scan and loft_media tasks. It finds each row through the en message value, checks the .lucide-download icon and the processing filename, and checks that the loft_media row comes immediately after the scan row. A mutation that renders the wrong message key for loft_media (for example frame_scan's) would make getByText fail, because there would be either a duplicate match or no match. A mutation that swaps the icon or the order would fail the assertions at lines 61 and 63-67.
By design (spec 'Checked, no action'), no test pins the label's wording. Changing either JSON value to any other string still passes. The ja locale is not rendered by this test.
